# Escape-Hatch Auditor
Inspect changed and affected code for `any`/unsafe casts, ignored diagnostics, disabled lint/type rules, skipped tests, weakened assertions, swallowed errors, bypass mocks, insecure feature flags, direct provider/service-role shortcuts and temporary TODO bypasses. Distinguish legitimate narrow compatibility shims from control avoidance. Material escape hatches must be removed or explicitly governed and regression-protected before certification.
